exceptions.rationale: Supplemental upstream version query, NOT exact +cpu build certification. Frozen actor uses feed-forward tensor operations; no torch.jit.script, lstm_cell, unpack_sequence, linalg.lu, rot90 or pt2 loading path found in current AI source. Integer conversion input remains bounded by validated observations. weights_only unpickling is used and remains vulnerable to crafted checkpoints: only operator-owned hash-verified immutable checkpoints may reach the loader. Hash identity is not a sandbox if the trusted producer is compromised. No arbitrary uploaded checkpoint inference is authorized.
exceptions.remediation: Versioned successor CPU runtime >=2.13.0 (current highest advertised fix), reevaluate unpatched PYSEC-2026-139 applicability, audit exact wheel/SBOM, perform deterministic tensor/load/tamper and isolated inference regressions, then source/image/model-bound requalification. Do not alter historical environment or weights.

exceptions.rationale: CVE-2024-23342 / GHSA-wj6h-64fc-37mp has no upstream fix. python-jose transitively requires ecdsa. Default JWT signing is HS256; cryptography extra is installed. No NANFO direct SigningKey/ECDH use found. This exception is invalid for deployments using python-ecdsa signing or key generation; configuration must be reviewed before enabling EC algorithms.
exceptions.remediation: Replace python-jose with a maintained JWT implementation in an auth-contract change; exercise issuer, expiry, refresh/revocation and algorithm confusion regressions. See ReviewClosure-Dependencies.md.

exceptions.rationale: Frozen historical runtime; upstream has no fixed release for these OpenFlow parser infinite loops. OpenFlow from lab OVS reaches the parser: malicious/compromised switches remain a real DoS risk. Exception applies only to isolated operator-owned emulation, never an untrusted switch or public controller service.
exceptions.remediation: Versioned successor controller/runtime and malformed-frame tests, then source/image-bound requalification; preserve historical bytes.

exceptions.rationale: Frozen Ryu requires ALREADY_HANDLED removed in later eventlet. WebSocket exhaustion, DNS interference and WSGI request smuggling remain unpatched here. No public WSGI/WebSocket listener is authorized; lab DNS and controller peers must remain isolated. PYSEC-2026-1307 and 2472 alias the same CVE but both exact feed IDs are reviewed.
exceptions.remediation: Successor runtime must remove legacy eventlet/Ryu coupling, exercise HTTP/WebSocket/DNS boundaries and requalify before promotion.

exceptions.rationale: Frozen eventlet DNS dependency is susceptible to TuDoor. Numeric lab addresses reduce routine DNS exposure; hostile network DNS remains a risk, not a proven unreachable path.
exceptions.remediation: Use dnspython >=2.6.1 in successor runtime with DNS regression and qualification.

exceptions.rationale: Frozen controller HTTP dependency; hostile Location targets can redirect off-host. No public redirect/SSO use is authorized in this operator-only lab. Do not expose Ryu web services to untrusted callers.
exceptions.remediation: WebOb >=1.8.11 in successor image; redirect/control-character tests and image requalification.

exceptions.rationale: Streaming Unpacker reuse after errors can crash. NANFO emulation exchanges JSON, not an exposed MessagePack input endpoint; transitively installed Ryu code still requires review before new RPC use.
exceptions.remediation: msgpack >=1.2.1 in successor image and malformed-stream regression.

exceptions.rationale: Frozen client dependency retains TLS-session verification persistence, netrc disclosure and zipped-path temporary-file flaws. Lab destinations must be operator-controlled; no host netrc credentials or shared writable temp mounts. These constraints limit exposure and do not patch the library.
exceptions.remediation: requests >=2.33.0 in versioned successor; TLS, redirect, credential and temporary-file regressions.

exceptions.rationale: Oversized attacker-controlled Unicode hostnames can consume CPU. Operator-defined numeric lab endpoints reduce exposure; arbitrary remote URL inputs are outside the exception scope.
exceptions.remediation: idna >=3.15 in successor image with hostname-boundary tests.

exceptions.rationale: Frozen HTTP dependency retains redirect/header leakage and response decompression DoS. Only controlled lab endpoints are authorized; malicious responses remain exploitable if that boundary fails. Do not use this runtime for arbitrary web fetching.
exceptions.remediation: urllib3 >=2.7.0 in successor image; bounded decompression and cross-origin redirect credential tests plus requalification.

coverage_gaps.rationale: Exact CPU wheel comes from download.pytorch.org, absent from PyPI audit inventory. This is an explicit coverage failure, not a clean Torch result. No version normalization or blanket package ignore is permitted.
coverage_gaps.remediation: The separate ai-upstream lane gates public torch 2.8.0 advisories but does not close this exact-build gap. Review exact CPU build/SBOM; any runtime change requires a new identity and requalification. Never load untrusted checkpoint/pickle inputs.
